howItWorks.heading: From WhatsApp To Finished Wall In 4 Steps
howItWorks.step1Body: Send us a photo of the wall, rough measurements if you have them, and the style you're leaning toward. We reply with options and a per-sqft estimate the same day.
howItWorks.step2Title: Free On-Site Measurement And Sample Drop
howItWorks.step2Body: We visit your home or office at a time that suits you, take exact measurements, walk you through real panel samples under your own lighting, and confirm the design direction.
howItWorks.step3Body: You receive a clean PDF quote with the promo price locked in, including free installation. Small deposit confirms the slot — usually 30%, refundable until install day if we let you down.
howItWorks.step4Body: Our crew installs the panels with hidden-clip mounting in a single visit (1–3 days for most rooms). We clean up before we leave — you wake up to a finished feature wall.

whyUs.heading: What You Actually Get When You Book With Us
whyUs.p1Body: No "labour from RM" surprises at the end of the project. Every per-sqft price already includes installation by our own trained team.
whyUs.p2Body: Our installers are full-time employees, trained on every style we sell. If something goes wrong on install day, the person fixing it works for us.
whyUs.p3Body: 12mm pre-finished panels mounted on hidden clips — no visible screws on the finished wall. Stronger, cleaner, easier to service later.
whyUs.p4Body: If a panel pops, lifts or fails because of our install — we come back and fix it. No paperwork drama.

faq.heading: Wall Panel Questions, Honestly Answered
faq.q1: How much does wall panel installation cost per sqft in Malaysia?
faq.a1: Standard Wall Panel finishes (Wood, Fluted, PVC, Acoustic) start from RM25/sqft. Marble Wall Panel finishes (Gold, Silver, Black) start from RM38/sqft. Both prices include free installation, hidden-clip mounting and clean-up. Final cost depends on total square footage and any custom cuts around outlets or windows.
faq.q2: Is free installation actually free, or are there hidden charges?
faq.a2: Free installation is fully included in the per-sqft price you see. No "labour from RM", no surprise transport fee, no after-hours surcharge. The only extras you might be quoted are major carpentry work or surface repair — and we always show that as a separate line so you can choose.
faq.q3: How long does wall panel installation take?
faq.a3: Most living rooms and bedrooms install in 1–2 days. Boardrooms, reception walls and larger spaces usually take 3–7 days end-to-end including measurement and finishing. We confirm an exact install window in your written quote so you can plan around it.
faq.q4: Do you install wall panels outside the Klang Valley?
faq.a4: Yes — we install across Malaysia including KL, Selangor, Johor, Penang, Ipoh, Negeri Sembilan, Melaka, Pahang, Kedah, Kelantan, Terengganu, Perlis, Sabah and Sarawak. Outstation jobs are quoted at the same per-sqft promo price; transport is included for orders above 200 sqft.
faq.q5: Which wall panel style works best for my space?
faq.a5: As a rough guide: Wood and Fluted suit living rooms and bedrooms; PVC suits kitchens, bathrooms and humid yards; Acoustic suits home offices, studios and meeting rooms; Marble suits luxury feature walls, reception areas and boardrooms. We bring real samples on the free measurement visit.
faq.q6: How durable are your wall panels?
faq.a6: All our panels are 12mm pre-finished and mounted on hidden clips — stronger and more service-friendly than glued installs. With normal care, expect 8–10 years of life on Wood and Marble panels, and longer on PVC and Acoustic. Workmanship warranty is included in writing.
faq.q7: How do I clean and maintain a wall panel?
faq.a7: Wipe with a dry microfibre cloth weekly. For PVC and Marble panels you can use a damp cloth with mild soap. Avoid harsh thinners or wire brushes on Wood and Acoustic finishes. We send a one-page care sheet with every install.
faq.q8: How do I book a free measurement?
faq.a8: Just WhatsApp us a photo of your wall, the rough dimensions and the style you're considering. We confirm a free measurement slot within the same day, send the installer over at the time you choose, and follow up with a written quote with the promo price locked in.
